recent_approving.title: Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Delhi v. Association of Victims of Uphaar Tragedy & Ors
recent_approving.label: FOLLOWS
recent_approving.speaker: court
recent_approving.sentence: In D.K. Basu vs. Union of India (1997) 1 SCC 416, a Constitution Bench of this Court held that there is no strait jacket formula for computation of damages and we find that there 75 is no uniformity or yardstick followed in awarding damages for violation of fundamental rights.
recent_approving.prev: The yardsticks normally adopted for determining the compensation payable in a private tort claims are not as such applicable when a constitutional court determines the compensation in cases where there is violation of fundamental rights guaranteed to its citizens.
recent_approving.next: In Rudal Shah’s case (supra) this Court used the terminology “Palliative” for measuring the damages and The formula of “Ad hoc” was applied in Sebastian Hongary’s case (supra) the expression used by this Court for determining the monetary compensation was “Exemplary” cost and the formula adopted was “Punitive” .

recent_approving.next: Therefore, it also includes within itself guarantee against the torture and assault by the States or his functionaries.”

recent_approving.title: S.P.S. Rathore v. State of Haryana & Ors
recent_approving.label: FOLLOWS
recent_approving.speaker: court
recent_approving.sentence: This legal position has been reiterated in D. K. Basu v. State Of W.B. [(1997) 1 SCC 416].
recent_approving.prev: In doing so the courts take into account not only the interest of the applicant and the respondent but also the interest of the public as a whole with a view to ensure that public bodies or officials do not act unlawfully and do perform their public duties properly particularly where the fundamental right of a citizen under Article 21 is concerned."
recent_approving.next: Compensation can be awarded for violation of fundamental rights in public law domain, but the facts of the case in hand do not justify the directions given in the impugned judgment for conducting of an enquiry by the District Judge so as to determine the compensation to be awarded to respondent No.5.

limits: Triage is a reading aid made by pattern rules over the sentences that name the case; it is not legal advice and not a verdict.
Only Supreme Court judgments we hold are searched; High Court treatment and judgments we lack are invisible.
Each quoted sentence was checked word for word against the judgment's text; the reading of it is a rule's, so a person must confirm.
The law reporter's case-law table (judgments of 2017 to 2023) is the reporter's annotation, not the court's words; judgments of 2024 on print no such table.
